lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for specific change types because no change type has at least two tests agreeing after noise correction.
Redesigning friend selection (adoption, redesign) and moving sign-in (sign_in, reorder) were helpful, winning their tests.
Updating onboarding intro story copy (choose_path, copy) made performance worse.
No clear effect was seen for waiting step info (home, wait_info), notification toggles (home, notification), or layout changes (finish, layout).
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for most specific change types because only choose_path copy and home wait_info have at least two tests.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse across multiple tests.
Waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Redesigning friend selection (adoption, redesign) and reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) were helpful, winning their tests.
Layout changes, notification toggles, and new visual tip screens had no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.
